snippet.title: Mega Man Battle Network Mashup Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
I have been developing this Mega Man Battle Network fangame for over 3 years and I almost have it in a demo ready state. It will be very unique compared to the mainline Mega Man Battle Network games in progression and structure along with being a love letter to the series. Hopefully you enjoy this reveal trailer even if the game is clearly still a work in progress at the moment.

Edit:
This game will be featured in SAGE 2026. I forgot to add the SAGE 2026 splash screen to this one but I will add it to the release trailer which will be very soon

The game is available to download through this link: https://www.sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/mega-man-battle-network-mashup.2904/

Join the discord server to stay up to date on its development: https://discord.gg/cCaKw48Jjs

I also stream on twitch here: https://www.twitch.tv/past88345
